name: Winamp Classic 2.x
author: Native Tribes
notes: kind=skin: this replaces SHAPES as well as colours. It is not a colour preset.
Authentic Winamp 2.x, per Joe's correction to the first pass.
The first attempt put phosphor green on EVERY widget edge, which is the one thing Winamp
never does. Real 2.x is three separate materials:
2. buttons  -- raised metal caps with a LIGHT top/left and DARK bottom/right bevel
(#787C88 highlight against #101014 shadow). Not outlines. Not green.
3. the LCD  -- the ONLY green thing: time readout, marquee, spectrum analyser, as
'bevel: 1' is what turns a flat stroke into a raised plate: the shader lights the top/left
edges and shadows the bottom/right, using the palette's edge and edgeShadow.
'edgeOverride' on 'energised' is what isolates the LCD -- that style keeps its phosphor
green while every other widget stays metal. A single global accent could not do this.
